content: Scoped export best practice: exports must enforce the same row-level visibility/access rules as the underlying view (a user should never be able to export more than they can see in the UI) — this is a common gap since export code paths are often implemented separately from view queries and can leak broader access than intended. Recommendation: drive CSV export from the same filtered/RLS-scoped query used for the on-screen list, not a separate unscoped query.
